pages.title: Creation from Nothing
pages.text: $(thing)Creation from Nothing$()$(br2)Before inflation, before time: a closed universe can tunnel into existence from no space at all, or begin without a boundary, its time becoming space near the start like the South Pole of a sphere. Quantum cosmology writes the wave function of the whole universe.

$(thing)Insight$(): 220$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Reheating, Vacuum Stability, Quantum Gravity.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Spin Foam Lattice.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Quantise a closed universe with only one degree of freedom, its radius a, filled with vacuum energy Λ. The Hamiltonian constraint becomes a Schrödinger-like equation with zero energy for the wave function ψ(a) of the whole universe: a kinetic term from the curvature of ψ, minus a potential a² − (Λ/3)a⁴ that forms a barrier between a = 0 and the classical universe (units with the factor 3π/2G absorbed). Write it.
